review.notes: Full re-review (885 changed lines since f4d3bc1). Gate rerun at this head: blob=2 (two commit-pinned links at README 1298 and 1613), every other counter 0, build=0, FAIL. Depcheck as written: 204 roadmaps, 1394 edges, 0 problems; probes with the abbreviated suppliers written out give UPWARD GeometricTopology (on main) -> TangentialBordism (#8) plus a CYCLE, and UPWARD -> TemperleyLiebOperatorAlgebras (#227): R01 and R02 (P2). TemperleyLiebOperatorAlgebras has no labels A1-A3. r13 R01-R04 and R06 repaired; R05 (companions) not repaired and extended by three new files, which elaborate at the pins after building their Tau Ceti imports (12, 9, 9 sorry warnings). Seeded sample: 1.1, 2.1, 4.1, 4.2, 4.5.1, 4.11, 5.3, 5.4, 6.2, 6.4, 7.2, 7.4, 8.5, 10.1, 11.2 checked (unchanged sections carried from r10-r13 with recomputed values). Sources read: Jones 1985 Bull. AMS and Squier 1984 (publisher-open); the 19-letter closed 4-braid counterexample to Jones's Corollary 24 reproduced in an independent exact Burau computation (Delta(zeta) = 36 - 13 sqrt 5 > 6.5), recorded as a source error. Murakami 1986 (J-STAGE 503) and Feller's thesis not readable; Rudolph 1982 paywalled, uncertified. Native API (jonesStateWeight, overPair, reducedBurauCol row convention, gaussSum quotient lemma) and Mathlib radical/lift/Nondegenerate opened at the pins. FourManifolds 1.4 at its open head builds the same knot/proper-link Arf invariant (P3, ownership statement).
